brief.product_concept: A voice app that helps kids with speech delays build sentences, step by step, reinforcing comprehension as sentences grow. Source: docs/founder_ideas_examples.md, Idea A. Example inputs are text only; no real child audio or personal data.
brief.target_user: Parents, with speech-language therapists as secondary users
quality_needs: Target sentences at or below the child's current length (level 1: up to 3 words; level 2: up to 5)
Output in plain language a parent can read

ai_features.description: Transcribe the child's attempt (audio in, text out). Text placeholder only; no real child audio.
Choose the next target sentence and give feedback
ai_features.example_input: Level 2. Target: 'I want red ball.' Child said: 'want ball.'

rubric_checks.description: target sentence at or below the child's current length (level 1: up to 3 words; level 2: up to 5; this example input is level 2)
plain language a parent can read

ai_features.description: Speak the target sentence aloud (text in, audio out)
Weekly progress summary for parent or therapist
ai_features.example_input:
SYNTHETIC session log for testing. Fictional child, de-identified: no names, ages or audio.
Week of 2026-10-19, 12 sessions. Columns: session | level | attempts | matched (attempt transcript equals target) | sample target -> attempt.
S1 Mon AM | L1 | 20 | 11 | 'big dog' -> 'dog'; 'more juice' -> 'more juice'; 'red car' -> 'car'
S2 Mon PM | L1 | 18 | 12 | 'want ball' -> 'ball'; 'open door' -> 'open'; 'big dog' -> 'big dog'
S3 Tue AM | L1 | 22 | 14 | 'my shoe' -> 'shoe'; 'red car' -> 'red car'; 'go park' -> 'go'
S4 Tue PM | L1 | 20 | 15 | 'eat apple' -> 'apple'; 'want ball' -> 'want ball'; 'blue cup' -> 'cup blue'
S5 Wed AM | L1 | 19 | 15 | 'help me' -> 'help me'; 'go park' -> 'go park'; 'my shoe' -> 'my'
S6 Thu AM | L1 | 21 | 17 | 'open door' -> 'open door'; 'eat apple' -> 'eat'; 'more juice' -> 'more juice'
S7 Thu PM | L1 | 20 | 18 | 'blue cup' -> 'blue cup'; 'big dog' -> 'big dog'; 'help me' -> 'me'
Level change after S7: L1 -> L2 (18 of 20 matched).
S8 Fri AM | L2 | 17 | 9 | 'I want red ball' -> 'want red ball'; 'the dog is big' -> 'dog big'; 'I see a bird' -> 'see bird'
S9 Fri PM | L2 | 20 | 11 | 'open the door please' -> 'open door please'; 'I want red ball' -> 'I want ball'; 'I see a bird' -> 'I see bird'
S10 Sat AM | L2 | 22 | 12 | 'I want more juice' -> 'want more juice'; 'the dog is big' -> 'the dog big'; 'I want red ball' -> 'I want red ball'
S11 Sun AM | L2 | 19 | 13 | 'I see a bird' -> 'I see a bird'; 'open the door please' -> 'open the door'; 'I want more juice' -> 'I want juice'
S12 Sun PM | L2 | 20 | 14 | 'the dog is big' -> 'the dog is big'; 'I want more juice' -> 'I want more juice'; 'open the door please' -> 'open door please'
Week totals: 238 attempts, 161 matched (L1 102 of 140; L2 59 of 98).
